# One topic, fresh reflections

The least-reflected-on selected interest receives a regular prompt with only matching logical-date history. A visible successful offer rotates to the other interest; a provider failure does not count as an offer. Explicit feedback preserves its exact question, sparse counts are explained, and saving, cached reload and complete replay perform no inference. Every user action is followed by an unmasked zero-pixel screenshot with checks underneath.

Viewport: desktop-chromium.
